basis: Vercel's runtime logs page: runtime logs include the output of the site's functions, kept 1 hour (Hobby), 1 day (Pro), 3 days (Enterprise) or 30 days (with Observability Plus)
this site's log lines record step names, sizes, durations and error kinds, never the question, a tool's arguments or a source's answer (src/lib/logs-carry-no-reader-content.test.ts)
so 'metadata' is this site's reading of those two facts, not Vercel's own claim: a question travels in a request's body, not its address
not measured: whether the platform keeps a request address's query part, which some pages use for what a reader types
keptBy.retention: 1 hour, 1 day, 3 days or 30 days, by the operator's plan, which this site cannot read

recipients.receives: what this site's own logs record of each request: which steps ran, how long they took and the kind of any error

keptBy.retention: as long as your account is active, and as needed for legal obligations

basis: measured: each run gets its own sandbox, created non-persistent and stopped after the run (src/lib/sandbox/vercel-sandbox.ts, persistent: false; src/lib/sandbox/execute.ts)

sources.freshness: Live: queries reach the portal when they are made (a dataset's metadata or a single record may be reused for up to five minutes); each dataset updates on its publisher's schedule.

basis: its privacy statement gives a retention rule for personal information and says nothing about what it keeps of a portal's data requests

sources.freshness: Live API over published statistical releases: a figure changes only when an agency publishes a new release, and each carries its release vintage (the ACS releases annually).

sources.displayName: NYC Charter, Laws and Rules MCP Server
sources.freshness: Pinned to version 0.3.1 of the publisher's package and the index it bundles: the Charter and the Administrative Code are current through Local Law 2026/147, enacted September 12, 2026, and the Rules through rules effective October 4, 2026.

basis: this site's setting: the sandbox is created persistent, keeps its last snapshot, and sets each snapshot to expire 30 days after its last use (src/lib/mcp/hosting/lifecycle.ts:96 SNAPSHOT_EXPIRATION_MS, and :322-329 persistent: true, snapshotExpiration, keepLastSnapshots 1)
Vercel's statement: "Snapshots expire 30 days after their last use by default." (https://vercel.com/docs/vercel-sandbox/concepts/snapshots, read 2026-10-20)
measured: the bridge's own log lines carry error kinds, versions and process ids, never a tool's arguments, and it writes no file per request (src/lib/mcp/hosting/bridge-source.ts)
not measured: what the source's own server writes to its error output, which reaches the sandbox's command log (bridge-source.ts, stderr: 'inherit')
